title: The Drift Relay Chain
logline: An independent packet runner fights to keep a string of low-margin frontier mail hops alive after an aggressive logistics conglomerate begins buying and scrapping the relays to isolate mining colonies.

roles.description: Inherited her deceased partner's battered postal runner; exhausted, fiercely loyal to remote mining outposts.
A cold asset manager buying up distressed communications routes to dismantle competitive freight channels.
A league of isolated colony settlements relying on scheduled packet boats for medical news and trade letters.
A decaying regional hub in the core system where frontier mail sacks are sorted and stamped.
An uncrewed solar relay buoy anchored in a neighbouring border system along the fringe jump corridor.
A remote pressurized habitat dock in an outer system cut off from mainline commercial comms.

public_situation: Fringe mining outposts across three star systems face complete isolation as automated relay buoys are systematically decommissioned by asset liquidators.
private_truth: {role:conglomerate_liquidator} is buying up defaulted packet franchises specifically to sever free communication, forcing frontier settlements into monopolistic corporate comms contracts.

beats.public_change: Central dispatch posts notices warning that overdue relay maintenance will suspend packet boat clearances within forty-eight hours.

missions.reason: She needs replacement solar battery capacitors purchased from commercial vendors and hauled to her dock before her courier license lapses.
missions.private_fact: She took an extortionate mortgage on her ship's engine core from the liquidator to pay for previous route permits.

beats.public_change: The jump beacon in the transit corridor powers down, leaving incoming cargo haulers blind without packet telemetry.

missions.reason: The border system's relay beacon went dark; she hires the pilot to scan the station's diagnostic telemetry and verify why power was cut.
missions.private_fact: She already suspected the liquidator cut the relay power manually, but lacked objective sensor proof to file an injunction.

beats.public_change: Corporate tugs arrive in the transit sector to commence demolition of the dormant solar relay buoy.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot handsomely to collect the buoy's core encryption slate and transfer custody directly to his corporate salvage office.
missions.private_fact: If the encryption slate is removed, the entire relay route legally reverts to unassigned corporate salvage under salvage statutes.

beats.public_change: The fringe habitat council convenes an emergency assembly to vote on whether to accept corporate data franchise terms.

missions.reason: She needs the emergency mail cylinder carried through the dark corridor to the isolated habitat before the settlement agrees to the buyout.
missions.private_fact: The cylinder holds cooperative funding vouchers that would allow the colony to purchase their own relay maintenance equipment.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to deliver formal foreclosure notices and corporate monopoly terms to the colony magistrates.
missions.private_fact: His contract locks the miners into triple-rate data fees for fifty years once signed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the cooperative mail cylinder, funding the colony's independent relay network.
resolutions.summary: {role:outpost_cooperative} buys their own relay equipment. {role:packet_courier} secures long-term mail contracts, breaking the liquidator's blockade.

consequences.public_summary: A long-haul courier braved dead jump sectors to keep independent mail lines flowing to isolated colonies.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot serves the corporate foreclosure notices to the colony habitat.
resolutions.summary: The colony signs the exclusive monopoly agreement. {role:conglomerate_liquidator} shuts down public relays, and {role:packet_courier} is forced out of business.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the contracts or abandons the mail run midway.
resolutions.summary: Without mail or funding, the frontier settlements capitulate to corporate terms. Public packet routes across the sector are permanently dismantled.

loose_threads.detail: The courier skiff's mortgage note was acquired by a blind investment trust that shares its physical address with the planetary mint.
Broadcast rights for the entire jump sector were auctioned off in a closed-door midnight sitting of the transport ministry.
The liquidator's inspection cutter flies with an emergency postal pennant stolen from a scrapped hospital shuttle.

radio_hooks: Outpost clusters in fringe sectors report losing connection to scheduled commercial packet hops.
{role:conglomerate_liquidator} announces acquisition of twelve bankrupt frontier communication corridors.
Independent courier unions protest rising gate tariffs on unescorted mail skiffs.

voice_direction.packet_courier: Fast, intense delivery flavored with pilot slang. Becomes defensive and sharp whenever her ship's mortgage is brought up.
voice_direction.conglomerate_liquidator: Smooth, calm, corporate articulation. Speaks entirely in passive voice about economic inevitability and efficiency.
